take: Per the Capitals' announcement, Washington placed D Rasmus Sandin on long-term injured reserve and D Matt Roy on injured reserve, and recalled D Justin Holl from Hershey (AHL). Roy has played 19:36 a night on the second pair and kills penalties, and the Capitals have controlled 57% of the 5-on-5 chances (expected goals) with him on the ice, about 6 points better than without him. Going by how the coach has used his players, Holl, at 12:59 a night, is next in line for those minutes, though the team has done worse with him on the ice so far (32% of 5-on-5 chances over three games).
